datasets.title: Blorenge launch landscape context
datasets.provider: Natural Resources Wales, OpenStreetMap contributors and Geofabrik
datasets.attribution: Contains NRW and Ordnance Survey information under the recorded attribution; © OpenStreetMap contributors; processed by Geofabrik.
datasets.method: Clip the allowlisted authoritative and community context fields to the exact SSSI-plus-2-km AOI and package vector tiles plus a non-map summary.
datasets.uncertainty: Source dates and completeness vary; contextual paths do not establish legal status.
limitations: The SSSI is not the Blorenge Common CL18 boundary.
OpenStreetMap paths are not a definitive rights-of-way record.
Phase 1 habitat is historical, not current condition.

datasets.title: Blorenge launch terrain context
datasets.method: Mosaic exact intersecting 1 m DTM tiles, average to 10 m inside the AOI, then derive fixed hillshade and 10 m contours.
datasets.uncertainty: Capture dates vary by tile and hillshade is a visualisation.
limitations: Not produced specifically for flood modelling.
Terrain does not describe current surface cover.

datasets.title: July 2026 Blaenavon wildfire and observed change
datasets.provider: European Union Copernicus programme, USGS and EFFIS; BCA processing
datasets.licence: Copernicus Sentinel data legal notice, USGS public domain and CC BY 4.0
datasets.attribution: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025–2026; Landsat imagery courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey; European Union, Copernicus EFFIS.
datasets.method: Apply SCL/QA masks, preserve not-observed pixels, calculate continuous dNBR, NDVI and NDMI change, use conservative three-state public evidence, and retain EFFIS as a separate provisional comparison.
datasets.uncertainty: The earliest passing Sentinel post-report observation is 11 August; Landsat 27 July corroboration is partial and not fused; evidence states are not locally calibrated severity.
limitations: Observed change is not proof of ecological recovery.
No exact, legal, surveyed or incident-authority perimeter is available.
EFFIS dates are not authority ignition, containment or stop times.
No claim is made about cause, habitat condition, soil damage or local severity.
